description: The full terms an image is sold under: what the buyer may and may not do with it. Read this before recommending a purchase, and whenever the person asks what they are allowed to do with an image. "personal" (the default) is what credits and a card one-off buy; "commercial" is the business licence, sold by card where price.commercial is offered.

code.description: One of: personal, commercial. Omit for personal.

version.description: Omit for the terms currently on offer. Pass a version to read what was sold earlier.
